news.headline: Ekeler led the team in carries, toting the rock one more time than fellow running back Rachaad White in the loss. Ekeler
news.detail: Ekeler led the team in carries, toting the rock one more time than fellow running back Rachaad White in the loss. Ekeler also was able to reel in multiple passes for the second time in three games, and he figures to remain in a relatively even backfield split with White against the Giants in Week 10
